description: backend.rs BackendChangesError::TooManyChanges { limit: 0 } maps to cannotCalculateChanges; limit > 0 maps to tooManyChanges with the suggested limit. This is a compact encoding that avoids a separate CannotCalculateChanges variant while preserving the semantic distinction RFC 8620 §5.6 requires. The invariant is tested and the Display impl makes the encoding self-documenting. A contributor might suggest adding a CannotCalculateChanges variant; the current encoding should be defended as adequate and simpler.
title: BackendChangesError limit=0 convention for cannotCalculateChanges is clean
